title: Caching, performance, and resilience — concept map
intro: This module covers how ASP.NET Core APIs stay fast and reliable under load: IMemoryCache and Redis IDistributedCache, response and output caching middleware, built-in rate limiting algorithms, Polly resilience on HttpClient, async patterns that avoid thread-pool starvation, EF Core query tuning, and diagnosing slow endpoints with dotnet-counters and p95 latency.

conceptCards.title: IMemoryCache + Redis
conceptCards.summary: Process-local L1 vs farm-wide IDistributedCache. Cache-aside, tenant keys, GetOrCreateAsync stampede protection.

conceptCards.title: Response vs output cache
conceptCards.summary: HTTP Cache-Control for CDN; output caching policies with EvictByTag. Vary by user for personalized routes.

conceptCards.title: Rate limiting
conceptCards.summary: Fixed window boundary burst; sliding smoother; token bucket mobile burst; concurrency for exports. 429 + Retry-After.

conceptCards.title: Polly resilience
conceptCards.summary: Retry transient 5xx, circuit breaker fail-fast, timeout on HttpClientFactory. No blind POST retry.

conceptCards.title: Async API performance
conceptCards.summary: async all the way; .Result causes thread-pool starvation. dotnet-counters threadpool-queue-length.

conceptCards.title: EF query performance
conceptCards.summary: AsNoTracking, projection, indexes on tenant+sort, fix N+1, compiled queries. Stats after bulk import.

conceptCards.title: Diagnosing slow APIs
conceptCards.summary: p95 not average; dotnet-counters + dotnet-trace; onboarding playbook: SQL scan vs starvation vs stampede.
